diffs.diff: distance_cm: datasheet reading gives 0.0172414 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: The model does carry this conversion, as sim.echo.usPerCm = 58.82 (0.0170 cm per us of echo high time) and US_PER_CM in the driver, a field the gate does not parse; it follows the Seeed wiki formula 'Distance = echo signal high time * Sound speed (340M/S)/2' (1/58.82 cm per us), while the second reading value 0.0172414 is the integer form in the Seeed library 'RangeInCentimeters = duration(timeout) / 29 / 2' (1/58 cm per us), the same physics within 1.4 percent.
